title: Other Financed Products and the GAP Benefit
content:
# Other Financed Products and the GAP Benefit

This coordination clause of the Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda states how other products financed on the same installment contract change the GAP benefit.

## Clauses in force

1. Holding other products financed on the same installment contract changes the GAP benefit.
2. Where the waiver subtracts refunds of cancelled financed products, the refunds of a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contract or a Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plan financed on the same purchase deal are subtracted as add-on refunds credited, because after a total loss those products are cancelled and their refunds go to the lienholder.
3. Products bought for cash or outside the deal are not subtracted.

## Retired clauses

- *"The amount subtracted is the refund each product's own terms compute with the loss date as the effective cancellation date, whether or not the cancellation has yet been processed."* — **no longer in force** as written for a GAP balance line priced under the current GAP balance pricing; every other GAP benefit subtracts the refund each product's own terms compute with the loss date as the effective cancellation date, whether or not the cancellation has yet been processed.
- *"Negative equity carried into the deal is read from the purchase deal (the trade-in payoff amount less the trade-in allowance) and is subtracted only where the waiver subtracts negative trade equity."* — **no longer in force** as written for a GAP balance line priced under the current GAP balance pricing; every other GAP benefit reads negative equity from the purchase deal (the trade-in payoff amount less the trade-in allowance).

## Which products count

| Product | Financed on the same deal | Bought for cash or outside the deal |
|---|---|---|
| Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contract | refund subtracted where the waiver subtracts add-on refunds | not subtracted |
| Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plan | refund subtracted where the waiver subtracts add-on refunds | not subtracted |

*Hypothetical case:* a holder bought a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contract inside the financed deal and paid cash for a Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plan; only the service contract's refund can be subtracted from the GAP benefit.

superseded_clauses: the amount subtracted is the refund each product's own charter computes with the loss date as the effective cancellation date, whether or not the cancellation has yet been processed
Negative equity carried into the deal is read from the purchase deal (trade_payoff_amount less trade_in_allowance) and is subtracted only where exclude_negative_equity is true.
